# Stories: audio assets and licences

Every sound in *The Distance Between Us* and *The Rules of the Game*, where it came from, and what we may do with it. Nothing here needs a network connection at run time: all of it is bundled in `assets/audio/`.

**Summary: no attribution is required for any asset, and no paid or restricted licence is involved.** Everything is either CC0, composed or synthesised for this app, or generated by our own Google Cloud TTS account. Crediting the recordists below is optional, and a courtesy worth doing if the app ever has a credits screen.

## Music: original, written for these stories

All 16 cues are composed and rendered by `scripts/story-audio/render.mjs`. There is no third-party composition in them.

| Story | Cue | Plays during | Made from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Distance | `dusk` | Arrival; neutral nights | The theme, plainly. CC0 sampled piano + synthesised strings |
| Distance | `thread` | Trades that were kept | Theme in F major, left-hand arpeggios |
| Distance | `unease` | After the breach | Low unresolved second; the theme gets two notes out |
| Distance | `echo` | Retaliation | Two figures answering across the stereo field, each lower |
| Distance | `frost` | The last night | Thin high strings; theme stops short of home |
| Distance | `span` | Ending: The Span | Theme resolved in D major, and answered |
| Distance | `line` | Ending: The Line Holds | No thirds in the pad; ends on a question |
| Distance | `banks` | Ending: Two Banks | Solo piano, phrases abandoned sooner each time |
| Rules | `hall` | Opening, choosing, designing | Glass pads and seeded bell notes |
| Rules | `encounter` | One-on-one rounds | 12-step against 16-step figures that drift in and out of phase |
| Rules | `echo` | The echo experiment | One note thrown back and forth through a delay |
| Rules | `trials` | The tournament | Layers enter as the field fills |
| Rules | `garden` / `iron` / `fog` | The three halls | Same materials: opened to major / a metallic semitone / with about 1 note in 12 slipping, as the simulation's moves do |
| Rules | `discovery` | The last trial and reflection | The pulse stops; A minor comes to rest on C |

**Why not licensed music?** The obvious source was ruled out by reading its terms. Mixkit's *Stock Music Free License* lists **video games as not allowed** and forbids remixing, and Tactiqo calls itself a game and needs to loop and edit. Pixabay's Content License looks workable but its site refuses automated access (HTTP 403), and I did not try to get around that.

## Recordings: all CC0 1.0, each verified on the sound's own page

`scripts/story-audio/fetch-sources.mjs` reads each sound's Freesound page and stops if it isn't marked Creative Commons 0. The downloaded previews are not committed (`.audio-src/` is git-ignored); `assets/audio/stories/credits.json` keeps the full machine-readable record. The MP3 previews are the public high-quality versions and need no account.

| Used as | Original title | Recordist | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crossing/ambience/wind` | LateSummer quiet woods and Leaves and Wind | kvgarlic | [669113](https://freesound.org/people/kvgarlic/sounds/669113/) |

| `crossing/ambience/rain` | Forestia RainOnLeaves Field-Recording | thinkingfish | [695619](https://freesound.org/people/thinkingfish/sounds/695619/) |
| `crossing/ambience/storm`, `sfx/thunder` | Thunder, med rolling, rain, mono | TRP | [572432](https://freesound.org/people/TRP/sounds/572432/) |

| `crossing/sfx/cloth` | Soft Fabric Rustle | IENBA | [850705](https://freesound.org/people/IENBA/sounds/850705/) |

CC0 is the uploader's own declaration; Freesound does not independently verify it. That is the normal, accepted basis for using this material, but it's worth knowing.

## Synthesised: no source material

Everything in `meridian/` (music, the room and fog beds, all nine effects), plus `crossing/sfx/shutter` and `crossing/sfx/plank`, is generated by code in `scripts/story-audio/`.

## Voices

232 clips (about 23 minutes) generated by `npm run tts` with Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, using the project's key, as the lessons' are. New voices are in `src/features/audio/voices.ts`: storyteller (Sulafat), Mira (Kore), Hollis (Iapetus), the Steward (Schedar).

## Regenerating

```bash
npm run stories:audio:fetch
```
```bash
npm run stories:audio
```
```bash
npm run stories:clips
```
```bash
npm run tts
```

The render tools `@breezystack/lamejs` (LGPL) and `mpg123-decoder` (MIT) are dev dependencies. They encode and decode files on a developer's machine, and are never bundled in the app. Their licences don't reach the audio they produce.

## Size

Music, ambience and effects 8.7 MB; narration 5.3 MB. About 14 MB added to the app's bundle in total.
